text:
alisa: Noticing a recurring pattern this week - small capacity dips in eu-west during high-concurrency bursts. Looks tied to older scheduler config + relaxed quota backstop. Verified on 3 different host pools. :thinking_face:
miguel: Can you paste the metric windows? gpu_util, queued_requests, headroom?
alisa: Quick snapshot: gpu_util spike to 92% for ~6m, queued_requests up ~40%, headroom dropped 18% -> 4% before autoscale kicked. Logs: https://redwood.internal/ops/logs/314159
devon: Those pools still run scheduler_v1 with aggressive packing and no per-tenant soft quotas. We rolled v2 in prod but missed some legacy pools.
ryan: TL;DR: legacy scheduler + no quota guard = slow preemption -> temporary headroom collapse. Migration + quota rules needed.
priya: Proposal: three actions — (1) add soft quota guards for user-facing tenants, (2) migrate legacy pools to scheduler_v2 (canary first), (3) add a daily short soak test for surge patterns. Owners? ETA?
alisa: I'll take (1) - add soft quota guards and an alert when soft quota usage > 80%. Target: EOD Thu. :white_check_mark:
miguel: I'll drive (2). Canary a single eu-west pool tomorrow, rollback-on-error. Staged rollout finishing next Tue. Will post playbook and rollback steps.
devon: I'll implement (3) - a 10m synthetic concurrent job simulating peak traffic and verifying headroom >= 12%. Start daily at 02:00 UTC. Will add to ops-runner schedule.
ops-bot: created incident-task INC-314159-A for quota-guard; due 2026-04-02.
ryan: Two config knobs to consider for v2 (for Miguel):
# scheduler_v2 tunables
max_packing_ratio = 0.7  # avoid overpacking latency-sensitive jobs
preempt_threshold_ms = 180000  # reduce preemption lag
Let's test these in canary.
priya: Short-term backstop: if headroom < 6% for >3m, route new requests to fallback model tier (smaller/cheaper). Who owns policy?
miguel: I'll own the fallback policy too. Can implement routing rule within 24h for eu-west only.
alisa: Summarizing owners/timelines:
- Soft quota guards: alisa — EOD Thu (3141660000)
- Scheduler v2 canary -> rollout: miguel — canary tomorrow, staged rollout by next Tue
- Daily soak test: devon — start 02:00 UTC daily, implemented today
- Fallback routing rule: miguel — 24h canary
devon: I'll add the soak test job and a dashboard panel for headroom by pool.
priya: I'll write a short post-action doc with runbook snippet and add to the incidents handbook.
alisa: Small ask: miguel, please add a blameless note in the migration PR about the telemetry we used so we can spot similar patterns earlier. :memo:
miguel: Will do and will post the PR link here when ready.
ryan: Follow-up: schedule a 30m retro next week to review recurring patterns across regions. I'll create the invite.
ops-bot: Task INC-314159-A updated: owner=miguel, status=assigned. Next update due in 48h.
alisa: Great work. Small wins + canary should reduce recurrence. Ping here when canary completes. :rocket:
